name: The Septuary
seat: the Mother Sept (a walled precinct on Velkash's White Step — the state is inside the capital)
summary: A state with almost no territory and enormous power: the Oath-Sept's walled precinct governs itself, certifies every major contract, betrothal, and succession in the Crownlands, and witnesses the realm's one lawful magical niche — certified cantrips. Its clerks are welcome everywhere and trusted nowhere.

government.title: First Clerk
government.current: First Clerk Hesperin of the Long Ledger
government.note: Chosen by seniority of service; the office has changed hands eleven times in forty years.

population.note: Hollow Sign notaries for southern trade

laws: Inside the precinct walls: Oath-Keeper's law absolute — perjury is the only capital crime. Outside them: the Septuary claims no land and enforces nothing, which is why everyone lets it in.

relations.note: The council funds the precinct and resents every seal.
Lineage certification is the Wealdmark's soft spot.
Certified cantrips are lawful magic; Censer wardens call the loophole 'the Sept's crack'.
Forged Septuary seals are the Mile's best-selling document after forged warrants.

history_notes: Chartered at the Crown Re-set (~120 AA) to end succession-by-sword among the rebuilt realms.
Has certified every High Reeve election since; no election it certified has ever been overturned.
adventure_hooks: A forged Septuary seal surfaces on a Censer warrant; finding the forger means the Mile owes players a favor — or a corpse.
Players must get a deathbed contract certified overnight; the First Clerk sets an impossible price.
The Septuary's ledger vault holds a certified cantrip record that proves someone cast magic lawfully — on the night of a murder.
